reason: I have never seen this machine on TV and no big company name is behind it, so I will not put twenty-two thousand into it. A normal semi-automatic from LG or Samsung costs about half, and the women manage when the power goes.
objection: If this company closes in two years, who will give me a battery or a motor? The dealer can promise anything today; with a big brand I know the service centre will still be there.
would_change_my_mind: If a big brand I know, like LG, Samsung or Godrej, made it and advertised it on TV, with service in our town.
